# Changing calendar cache state can replace the calendar object

Entry 1463 reports that gCalendar is no longer the right object after changing cache state. The accepted manager removes the old calendar without deleting remote data, creates and copies properties to a new calendar, then registers it so the cached facade can be wrapped or unwrapped. The properties dialog therefore saves identity, scheduling, notification and disabled settings before changing cache.enabled last. In this dialog, recommend treating the cache setter as an object-replacement boundary rather than an ordinary independent property write. No test, build or runtime operation was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is pending; source adoption does not establish reviewer approval.

Scope: Calendar cache replacement ordering.
